summary: Alexandr Wang describes a co-trained model-and-agent system with improved first-attempt tool-call success, a 1M token context window, and an autonomous run of over 1,000 tool calls on a kernel-optimization task on Nvidia Hopper.

mechanisms.reason: The post states a specific, large context window figure for the model.
A single self-reported example of an agent autonomously executing over 1,000 tool calls, not an industry-scale claim.
mechanisms.quote: we pointed it at kernel optimization on nvidia hopper and let it run. 1,000+ tool calls

practices.reason: The stated gains in tool-call success and context length are relevant to teams building agentic tool-using pipelines but are unreplicated first-party claims from a short post.
practices.quote: we co-trained the model and agent together. the result: higher first-attempt success on tool calls, cleaner plan execution, less time re-prompting. 1m token context window.
